skill_name: Write a paragraph expressing the importance of online privacy.
workflow: Online privacy is of paramount importance in this digital age. We often share personal and sensitive data online, from our browsing histories to our credit card information, giving criminals plenty of opportunities for exploitation. Online privacy helps to protect us from data breaches and other malicious activities.
